<thought>We need to generate the ML-ready dataset using the provided consolidated JSON and parameters, then create a metadata JSON file pointing to the generated train and test files and listing the features. We'll call the `prepare_tabular_dataset` tool with the given arguments, then inspect the output directory to find the generated files, read the features list (if provided), and finally write a metadata JSON file and return its path.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{

    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_4/sulphide_ml_dataset",

}
